test_description: Production ingress path connectivity — verify actual path taken by packets entering avid_daemon via --stim-bin vs avid_validate_packet
input_contract: Production daemon must validate external --stim-bin packets through avid_validate_packet rather than overwriting flags/seq_id
independent_oracle: Direct source + runtime verification on avid_daemon_under_test with truncated 3-byte and invalid-flag --stim-bin files

expected.daemon_ingress_validation: Reject truncated 3B --stim-bin and preserve/validate raw packet flags & seq_id

actual.daemon_ingress_validation: truncated_3B --stim-bin exited rc=0; unpacks raw without avid_validate_packet and re-stamps AVID_PKT_FLAG_VALID

assertion_notes: PRODUCTION INGRESS BYPASS: `avid_daemon.cpp:398-408,491` accepts a 3-byte truncated `--stim-bin` with rc=0 (synthesizing sx=0, sz=0 on short `fread`) AND unpacks `--stim-bin` words via `avid_unpack_packet_u64` without calling `avid_validate_packet`, then re-packs every word with fresh `AVID_PKT_FLAG_VALID` and `seq_gen++` before `avid_dma_ring_push_burst`!
